title: My Taste
reported_observation: Official documentation says My Taste uses listening and creation habits for personalized experiences and Style Augmentation.
creator_interpretation: Personalization is a potentially important confound for multi-user comparisons.
our_hypothesis: The same text prompt might produce different outputs across users when personalization/augmentation differs, and identical outputs across settings should not be presumed.
